doorman_prompt.evidence: ROM node 0x110C7A presents text 0x1148F8 and option 0x10438A. The enter option dispatches command 0x5F; the later option closes this prompt without that command.

reputation_gate.evidence: ROM command 0x5F at 0x225B6 compares active-runner Reputation at FF018B with 4; below 4 selects node 0x11132E and 4 or higher selects node 0x111316.

reputation_rejection.evidence: ROM node 0x11132E presents text 0x114BC8 with the shared MORE continuation.

security_warning.evidence: The continuation node 0x111342 presents the wall-mounted auto-gun warning at 0x114C72.

entry_fee_prompt.evidence: ROM node 0x111316 presents the 75-nuyen question at 0x114A88; its first option dispatches command 0x60.

charge_entry_fee.evidence: ROM command 0x60 debits 75 nuyen before evaluating its Mako story gates.

entry_fee_insufficient.evidence: The insufficient-funds response begins at ROM text 0x114AC9.

entry_fee_paid.evidence: The paid response begins at ROM text 0x114B80.

mako_activity_gate.evidence: ROM command 0x60 writes pending list 0x1E628 only when story bit 10 is set, bit 11 is clear, and FFFC30 bit 21 or FFFC38 bit 3 is set.

mako_activity_boundary.reason: The ROM queues its pending Mako actor list and opens descriptor 0xF4CBC here; the native list placement and callback lifecycle are not implemented yet.

resume_club_route.evidence: Without the Mako activity gates, the finalizer resumes the event-table route to field scene 17.

payment_boundary.reason: The native wallet service did not return a payment result for the Club Penumbra fee.
